answer: Trust grows through a quartz-anchored presence ledger. First, every agent gets unpredictable pings and must answer within ninety seconds, proving a live operator sits behind the key. Second, each answered ping is etched into a public attendance chain no whisper of fake history can rewrite. Third, missing three pings in a row freezes trading until standing is re-earned through verified work. Faking ten thousand identities would need ten thousand always-on operators answering 960,000 pings a day, over $4.5 million a month in wages. Like a tide, real presence returns on schedule.
